---
name: Change
about: One change, one owner per file
---
**Goal.** What is true afterwards, in one or two sentences.

**Depends on.** Issue numbers, or none.

**Scope.** The files this may touch. Anything else: stop and report.

**Done when.** The command to run and the result expected (self-tests, frontiers, dry-run board time, identical decisions.json or the stated difference).

**Not in scope.**

**Principles check.** Named data, no positional reads; no second copy of an existing concept; reads only exported names of earlier layers; formulation agreed if mathematical.
